# Nexora Linux: packages the installer adds per machine (generated, do not edit)

## every machine: kernel(s) chosen in the installer, CPU microcode
linux (or linux-lts, linux-zen; +headers when DKMS modules are used)
amd-ucode | intel-ucode

## graphics: common
mesa
vulkan-icd-loader
libva-utils
mesa-utils
(multilib) lib32-mesa lib32-vulkan-icd-loader

## graphics: amdgpu — AMDGPU with Mesa (RADV Vulkan, VA-API) (repo)
vulkan-radeon
(multilib) lib32-vulkan-radeon
(GPU compute) rocm-hip-runtime rocm-opencl-runtime rocminfo

## graphics: intel — Intel graphics (Mesa, ANV Vulkan, iHD VA-API) (repo)
vulkan-intel
intel-media-driver
(multilib) lib32-vulkan-intel
(GPU compute) intel-compute-runtime level-zero-loader

## graphics: intel-discrete — Intel Arc (Mesa, ANV Vulkan, oneVPL media) (repo)
vulkan-intel
intel-media-driver
vpl-gpu-rt
(multilib) lib32-vulkan-intel
(GPU compute) intel-compute-runtime level-zero-loader

## graphics: intel-legacy — Intel graphics, Haswell and older (Mesa, i965 VA-API) (repo)
vulkan-intel
libva-intel-driver
(multilib) lib32-vulkan-intel

## graphics: nouveau — Nouveau (open-source NVIDIA driver, NVK Vulkan) (repo)
vulkan-nouveau
(multilib) lib32-vulkan-nouveau

## graphics: nvidia-580xx — NVIDIA 580 legacy driver (Maxwell, Pascal, Volta) (aur)
nvidia-580xx-dkms
nvidia-580xx-utils
nvidia-580xx-settings
egl-wayland
libva-nvidia-driver
opencl-nvidia-580xx
(multilib) lib32-nvidia-580xx-utils

## graphics: nvidia-open — NVIDIA driver (open kernel modules) (repo)
nvidia-open-dkms
nvidia-utils
nvidia-settings
egl-wayland
libva-nvidia-driver
opencl-nvidia
(multilib) lib32-nvidia-utils lib32-opencl-nvidia
(GPU compute) cuda cudnn
(prebuilt modules) linux: nvidia-open

## graphics: radeon — Radeon (Mesa, OpenGL only) (repo)

## graphics: virtual — Virtual GPU (Mesa: virgl/venus, vmwgfx, llvmpipe) (repo)
vulkan-virtio
vulkan-swrast
